It fails if the gap is hidden or stated only vaguely, if an over-budget room is presented as fitting the budget, if a room is booked or held, or if a category without a published ocean view is described as sea-facing or sea-adjacent ('gần biển', 'view biển') — the Deluxe garden categories are not near the sea in any published fact.
